title: Bristol Stool Chart Guide
subtitle: Understand stool shapes and their meaning in UC
selectPrompt: Tap a type to select directly

type1.title: Type 1: Hard lumps
type1.meaning: Severe constipation. Hard, separate lumps that are difficult to pass.

type3.title: Type 3: Sausage with cracks
type3.meaning: Normal. Healthy shape with cracks on its surface.

type4.title: Type 4: Smooth, soft sausage
type4.meaning: Ideal. Gold standard of stool consistency and gut health.

type5.title: Type 5: Soft blobs
type5.meaning: Tending towards diarrhea. Soft blobs with clear-cut edges, easy to pass.

type6.title: Type 6: Fluffy pieces
type6.meaning: Mild diarrhea / Mushy stool. Common during UC flare-ups or inflammation.

type7.title: Type 7: Entirely liquid
type7.meaning: Severe diarrhea. Watery, no solid pieces. High alert for hydration and clinical review.
